$comment: Root's independent reviews of change-impact-plan 1.4.1, rounds 1-3 (2026-10-26): 245 adversarial reader files, plus S01-S05 and SP01-SP07 (spine's own probes). Each must READ its truth packages or REFUSE (which plans FULL). Round 4 adds R4T01-R4T63 (rule 7: every taint shape must refuse) and R4R01-R4R11 (rule 7's precision: each binding and scoping narrowing must keep reading). expect: read = must not refuse (precision); sound = read or refuse; refuse = must refuse; residual = A12/N08/N11 (object values and keys, root's ratified metadata) and T19/T36/T37 (lexical limits proposed to root, not ratified). Round 5 adds root's round-4 reviewer inputs (V01-V70, M1-M6, X1-X6, K05-K10) and R5T01-R5T07/R5R01-R5R04; residual adds M5/M6/V48 (a literal root read does not start taint) and V45-V47 (heads taken by tuple slicing, a regex or os.path.split). Round 6 adds the fifth review's R5V01-R5V54 and Z1-Z7; inputs outside README rule 4's closed list are named residuals. Round 7 adds the sixth review's R6V01-R6V30 and Q1-Q3 (R6V12-R6V14 now refuse: a package.json that does not parse as a JSON object, or whose scripts is not an object; R6V15 reads once its UTF-8 BOM is stripped; R6V18, R6V19 and R6V21-R6V25 are named residuals outside rule 4's closed list; R6V02/R6V03 are the ratified YAML-key metadata) and R7T01-R7T20 (round 7: T01-T07 and T13-T15 refuse the package.json forms, NaN/Infinity and an integer too long to decode included; T08-T11 are precision controls that read; T12 pins that a TOML key reads; T16, T19 and T20 refuse and pin the working-directory wording; T17/T18 are named residuals, a name another function binds). Round 8 adds the seventh review's B1a-B1d (R7B1a/R7B1c: a tainted name inside a string or substitution, a quoted JS cwd key, named residuals; R7B1b/R7B1d refuse) and R7V14 (a root mention after an invalid UTF-8 byte reads, src_hex holding its raw bytes), and R8T01-R8T04 (the same wording's edges). The R7T02 CI fix adds R8T05 (a package.json nested 100 deep refuses at the explicit 64-level bound, the same on every Python) and R8T06 (exactly 64 deep, read). Each residual carries `reads`, its reading when pinned: judge() asserts it exactly, so a residual that reads less (or more) than recorded fails until the pin is re-derived on purpose. Round r5 (2026-11-12, root's R-c ruling, lanes/root/reviews/rc-vectors-r4-1112.md) adds 141 cases flagged "r5": true for the B2 declaration reader: each refuse pins its rule as expected_rule, each accept carries an ablation (src/cfg/files/symlinks) that must read no truth (construct+declaration) or refuse for its case-level ablation_expected_rule (declaration); 91 refuse, 43 read, 6 controls (REVIEW_CONTROLS), 1 named residual. The same commit adds 19 KFO_ cases copied from root's #84 probes for the dated fail-opens D1-D4, C01-C04 and N3: each carries known_fail_open {gap, until, today, record} and judge() holds it to its pinned reading until a rule closes the gap; on or after `until` a pin still present fails.
